dialogueText: You survived the approval attack. Good. But survival is not mastery.

choices.text: 🗣️ "I wasn't sure if it was real"

followUp.tempted: Greed is the oldest exploit. Every scammer knows this. Remember — if the reward is free, YOU are the product.
followUp.uncertain: Doubt is your first shield. But you must turn doubt into verification. Check the contract, not your feelings.
followUp.cautious: Good instinct. Reading before signing is the mark of a survivor. Keep that habit.
